```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to operator"

edge checkcounters -> errorsfound
edge errorsfound -> clearcounters "yes"
edge errorsfound -> escalate "no"
edge clearcounters -> monitor
```

Notes on this fix: the prior attempt wrote edges as bare `id -> id` lines, which the validator rejected as not-allowed statements in the `flowchart` genre — the grammar is closed, so every statement needs an explicit keyword. I changed each connection line to start with `edge`, matching the pattern used for node statements (`process`, `decision`, `terminator`). I don't have `reference/experimental/flowchart.md` loaded in this session to confirm `edge` is the exact required keyword rather than some other spelling; if `node <this-skill-dir>/build-svg.js` still reports a line error on these edge lines, the error message should name the correct keyword/replacement per the "retired spellings are hard errors" rule, and that should be used instead of guessing further.
